behaviors.find-percentage-calculator: The Percentage calculator appears in the Math tools and opens at /percentage-calculator.
behaviors.calculate-percent-of-value: Entering a percentage and a value shows the calculated amount.
behaviors.calculate-value-as-percent: Entering two values shows what percentage the first is of the second.
behaviors.calculate-percentage-change: Entering a starting and ending value shows the percentage increase or decrease.
behaviors.show-empty-incomplete-result: A calculation’s result stays empty until both of its inputs are filled.
behaviors.copy-calculated-result: The copy button copies a calculated result to the clipboard.

history.notes: The calculator inputs use the test IDs established by the PR’s end-to-end tests. The copy step targets the button inside the result component and reads the clipboard to verify the copied value.
The calculator uses data-test-id attributes, so CSS attribute locators replace Playwright’s default getByTestId locators. The navigation locator is scoped to the Math category in the sidebar.
